title: Internal Value Alignment in Large Language Models through Controlled Value Vector Activation

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting frequent context word analysis on LLM-generated training data to identify spurious linguistic correlations (e.g., the words 'digital' or 'financial' dominating the human value of 'security'), comparing word frequencies between positive and negative samples.

Prompting models with open-ended dilemma scenarios and using GPT-4o alongside human annotators to calculate a Control Success Rate (CSR), measuring whether the model's outputs prioritize target dimensions from Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values.
